title: Open Review changes on a Story card in Intent

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained Chromium check caught the wrong baseline in the file-note composer for a renamed file in a landed run.

- **Story and revision.** `SEED-420#open-review-changes-from-a-story-card` at `d8561e79753993137bec7767cf2a147f957064ae`. The scope promises that file and line actions on a diff keep their comparison context. Plan 777 records the migrated Intent note proof under G13.
- **Fault.** In the isolated checkout, `dashboard/src/IntentComparedFile.tsx:45` passed the landed tree as the `ReviewedFileHeader` baseline. The file diff, the landed-rename fixture, and all assertions were kept intact.
- **Maintained check.** The case in `dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-note-context.spec.ts:16` opened a Done Story card’s Changes, selected `old-name.ts → new-name.ts`, verified the diff’s `+changed` content, and opened Add note. The assertion at line 40, through `storyNotesPage.ts:72`, expected the landed range from the fixture’s `…0001` baseline to its `…0002` tree. The baseline run passed. The faulted run failed that assertion.
- **Observed behavior.** The faulted browser’s form snapshot at `okcj@199` in `faulted-trace.zip` showed the Add note heading, Intent → Changes, both paths, and the rendered range `Landed run …0002 → …0002`. This independently shows that the reached composer presented the wrong baseline. The faulted run stopped at the composer assertion, before the save step.
- **Restoration.** Restored the original source, verified that the checkout’s Git status matched its clean baseline, and reran the exact command. The restored check passed. The detached scratch worktree was removed. Logs, the single-line fault diff, and the browser trace remain under `/tmp/open-dough-coverage-777.MPMIxD7e`.

**Next proof action.** Retain the maintained landed-rename composer assertion for this comparison-context path.

- **Test runtime.** 12.3 s baseline, 7.7 s faulted, and 11.6 s restored, measured by the Playwright case timer.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. Human time was not recorded for the probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent time was not separately recorded from build and test waits.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 316673 ms (measured), from 1795410201870 to 1795410518543 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked d8561e79753993137bec7767cf2a147f957064ae, Caught, existing assertion retained and no follow-up.
